Mummy
Zara the Mummy is a Mummy trader at the Circus of the Last Days. She sells dyes and disguise kits, though her intentions as a trader are hidden behind muffled grunts.
“
Mmhm. Mmmhm?
„
— Zara attempting to communicate with the party

Involvement

Zara is at her tent at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington at X: -52 Y: -75. The words that attempt to escape her desiccated, undead, presumably tongueless mouth are indecipherable.

Understanding her requires passing one of the following ability checks:

  • [WISDOM] Try to interpret her hand movements. (DC 10)
  • [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM] Read her thoughts, trying to glean her intentions.
    • Zara
      Does this arsehole not understand Common?! DO. YOU. WANT. TO. BUY. FACE-PAINTS?
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] ROAAAAR! (DC 10 )
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Grunt back menacingly at the mummy. (DC 10 )

Neither of these checks are actually required in order to access her trade inventory, as it is still possible to press the 'Trade' button in the lower-left corner during dialogue to access her wares at any point.

Trade inventory

Zara always stocks the following:

  • Disguise Kit
  • Face-Painting Kit - 4x - one for every present party member should they go directly into fighting  Dribbles.
  • Scroll of Disguise Self

She also pulls additional stock from the Dye Subtable.

Zara behaves exactly like  Withers when it comes to stealing: whether successful or not, Zara does not react or search for the offending character, nor does she call upon authorities to do so; if a dexterity skill check is failed at any time while trying to steal from her, she does not react, and the player character can continue trying until they succeed.

Combat

Zara has abilities typical of a regular Mummy.
